summary: Revise contract: Enhance Taskboard so Investigate, Plan, Build and Review hand off AUTOMATICALLY into distinct fresh native threads with compact context and the same task workspace; automatically attempt bounded recovery of actionable Build blockers before requiring Continue, but never invent required decisions or retry uncertain dispatches. Fix stale paused/finished UI when a linked native session is working, and replace scattered Open session buttons with a scalable stage/session navigator and a coherent state-aware action area. Preserve existing result/error UI and safe workflow boundaries.

state.request: Improve Taskboard UI/UX for structured completion results shown in BB threads and for errors displayed inside Taskboard tasks. Replace raw JSON-like result blocks such as {"verdict":"blocked","findings":"..."} with a compact, scannable status presentation that preserves full detail, and improve task error states so they communicate what failed, what the user can do, and optional technical details. Keep the work scoped to plugins/taskboard, follow existing design patterns, preserve accessibility and responsive behavior, and verify the real UI in a browser with screenshots plus focused tests.

sizeDecision.reason: The seven criteria describe one user-visible presentation change across a shared result contract: the native result card, backward-compatible parsing, and actionable error state must be changed and verified together to avoid a half-migrated protocol or duplicated controls.
